name: Dr. Ayesha Rahman
description: Highly experienced cardiologist specializing in heart diseases, preventive care, and patient-centered treatment. Dr. Ayesha has treated over 5000 patients and is known for her thorough diagnostic approach.

name: Dr. Rahim Chowdhury
description: Renowned neurologist with expertise in stroke management, epilepsy, and neurodegenerative disorders. Completed advanced training at Johns Hopkins University.

name: Dr. Nadia Islam
description: Expert dermatologist specializing in skin disorders, cosmetic dermatology, and laser treatments. Passionate about providing personalized skincare solutions.

name: Dr. Kamal Hossain
description: Senior orthopedic surgeon with expertise in joint replacement, sports injuries, and spine surgery. Has performed over 2000 successful surgeries.

name: Dr. Sabrina Akter
description: Experienced gynecologist specializing in maternal health, high-risk pregnancies, and minimally invasive surgery. Known for compassionate patient care.

name: Dr. Faisal Ahmed
description: Dedicated pediatrician focused on child health and development, vaccinations, and chronic illness management in children. Loved by parents and kids alike.
